description: Total cost of selling a Canadian home and what you walk away with: commission + GST/HST (province starting rates, all overridable), legal fees, mortgage discharge fee and other costs, then net proceeds after the mortgage is paid off.

buyerSideSharePct.description: Share of the commission paid to the buyer's brokerage, percent

firstTierRatePct.description: Override, tiered only: percent on the first tier, e.g. 7

mortgageDischargeFee.description: Lender's mortgage discharge fee in CAD

otherCosts.description: Other costs in CAD: staging, repairs, moving

province.description: Province or territory; sets the commonly quoted starting rates

remainderRatePct.description: Override: percent on the balance (tiered) or whole price (flat)

remainingMortgage.description: Mortgage balance paid out at closing

salesTaxRatePct.description: Override: GST/HST percent charged on the commission

structure.description: Override: tiered (e.g. 7% on first $100k) or flat % of the whole price

tierThreshold.description: Override, tiered only: price up to which the first-tier rate applies

name: cost_of_selling
title: Cost of Selling a House Calculator (Canada)
